title: SF90 (2023-2024 Regular): Permitted and trained school staff firearm carry authorization

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-06; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/90/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced 2023-01-06. Strikes only an 'or' and a period in 609.66 subd. 1d to add clause (10). Text is word-for-word identical to the companion bill (SF 90 and SF 942). The training program (paragraph (a)) is quoted from the middle of a sentence after its subject, joined as printed.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26, new), paragraph (a): The superintendent of the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, in consultation with security and law enforcement experts with appropriate qualifications and experience in responding to active shooter situations, must establish a school and postsecondary institution teacher and employee firearm training program that includes at a minimum training in active shooter situations.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26, new), paragraph (b): The training program must admit only school and postsecondary institution teachers and employees who have completed training for a permit to carry under section 624.714 within one year of the date of attending the training under this section or have a permit to carry under section 624.714.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d), paragraph (f): (10) teachers and employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137 who have a school permit to carry under section 624.714, subdivision 8b.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b, new), paragraph (a): A teacher or other employee of a public elementary, middle, or secondary school; charter school under chapter 124E; or postsecondary institution under chapter 136F or 137 may apply to the sheriff of the county where the teacher or employee resides for a school permit to carry.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b, new), paragraph (b), clause (3): (3) has successfully completed the training program under section 299C.26 within one year of the date of the application for the school permit to carry;
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 8b, new), paragraph (h): A school permit to carry issued under this subdivision expires one year after the date of issue.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18), paragraph (d): (d) This subdivision does not apply to teachers and employees authorized to carry firearms under section 609.66, subdivision 1d, paragraph (f).
